currencyNote: The core game still uses normalized simulation dollars for balance. India reference labels/models and depreciation rules are educational references; they are not live dealer quotations or tax advice.

accounting.note: Book depreciation uses straight-line allocation over the configured useful life. Schedule II useful lives are used as the India reference where applicable.

tax.note: Tax WDV rates are displayed for learning but are not currently used to calculate the game's simplified income tax. Actual tax depreciation depends on asset block, put-to-use timing and law.

maruti_swift.label: Maruti Suzuki Swift — business car
maruti_swift.indiaReference: India-market passenger car; live on-road/ex-showroom price varies by variant, state and date.
maruti_swift.description: Useful for local travel, customer pickup/drop, sales visits and as a dealership demo vehicle.

tata_nexon_ev.label: Tata Nexon EV — electric business car
tata_nexon_ev.indiaReference: India-market EV; live price varies by battery/variant, incentives, state and date.
tata_nexon_ev.description: An EV operating asset that can support customer movement, demonstrations or field operations.

toyota_innova_hycross.label: Toyota Innova Hycross — premium MPV
toyota_innova_hycross.indiaReference: India-market MPV; live price varies by variant, state and date.
toyota_innova_hycross.description: Higher-cost customer/fleet vehicle with more service capacity and a larger capital commitment.

mahindra_xuv700.label: Mahindra XUV700 — SUV
mahindra_xuv700.indiaReference: India-market SUV; live price varies by powertrain, trim, state and date.
mahindra_xuv700.description: A larger vehicle suited to field sales, executive transport or rugged operating environments.

hire_taxi.label: Commercial taxi / fleet car
hire_taxi.assetClass: Motor taxi used in business of running on hire
hire_taxi.indiaReference: Configured as an on-hire vehicle for depreciation learning; actual registration/permit economics vary.
hire_taxi.description: Higher-utilization vehicle: shorter book useful life, higher maintenance and a higher tax WDV reference rate.

workshop_lift.label: Two-post hydraulic vehicle lift
workshop_lift.indiaReference: Common automotive workshop equipment; vendor price and capacity vary.
workshop_lift.description: Raises workshop throughput and makes underbody/brake/suspension jobs possible.

alignment_machine.label: 3D wheel alignment machine
alignment_machine.indiaReference: Common tyre/alignment workshop equipment; live vendor pricing varies.
alignment_machine.description: Adds alignment capability, improves service quality and supports higher-value repair jobs.

diagnostic_scanner.label: Professional automotive diagnostic scanner
diagnostic_scanner.indiaReference: Professional multi-brand workshop diagnostic tool; coverage/subscription costs vary.
diagnostic_scanner.description: Improves fault diagnosis, technician productivity and customer trust.

tyre_machine.label: Tyre changer + wheel balancer
tyre_machine.indiaReference: Common tyre service equipment; live price varies by automation and capacity.
tyre_machine.description: Adds tyre replacement/balancing services and expands workshop job capacity.

computer_laptop.label: Business laptop / desktop
computer_laptop.description: Short-life IT asset used for accounting, CRM, diagnostics, design or operations.

office_furniture.label: Office/showroom furniture set
office_furniture.description: Improves customer-facing premises and creates a depreciating balance-sheet asset.

cessna_172s.label: Cessna 172S Skyhawk
cessna_172s.indiaReference: Imported light aircraft; India landed/operating cost can differ materially from overseas list prices.
cessna_172s.description: Light aircraft example for learning high-value capex, depreciation, maintenance and liquidity risk.

pilatus_pc12.label: Pilatus PC-12 NGX
pilatus_pc12.indiaReference: Imported business/turboprop aircraft; purchase and operating costs can be many crores of rupees.
pilatus_pc12.description: Large capital commitment illustrating depreciation, financing pressure and asset utilization.

embraer_phenom_300e.label: Embraer Phenom 300E
embraer_phenom_300e.indiaReference: Imported business jet; landed cost, duties, maintenance and operating structure vary materially.
embraer_phenom_300e.description: Business jet example intended mainly for advanced capital-allocation and depreciation learning.

bank_fd.label: Company Bank Fixed Deposit
bank_fd.note: Educational simulated return, not a live bank quote. Principal does not depreciate in the fixed-asset sense.

treasury_bill.label: Short-term Government Treasury Investment
treasury_bill.note: Simplified cash-management instrument for learning; return is a simulation assumption, not a live yield.
